class.name: IfcCurveBoundedSurface
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 The curve bounded surface is a parametric surface with curved boundaries defined by one or more boundary curves. One of the boundary curves may be the outer boundary; any number of inner boundaries is permissible.
